scope: 仅生成并保存三张游戏背景；故事绑定与浏览器验收由主代理执行。

assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: finished visual novel game background. Create one new environmental scene derived from these references, no collage.
Reference roles: first input bg-street.png is ONLY the exact cinematic semi-realistic game-art finish and cool gray-teal rainy night / restrained amber light palette reference; the second photo is the modern Bijie sloping residential street architecture reference; third photo is the ordinary gray and red brick local buildings reference, do not include its person.
Scene: contemporary Bijie, Guizhou, outside the modest side entrance of an aging neighborhood karaoke venue, rainy night. Camera at standing eye height under a wide practical shelter/eave, looking out over a sloping residential street. Left quarter: a half-closed simple metal-and-glass side door, concrete steps, one restrained warm wall lamp. Across the road in left-center distance a softly blurred small noodle shop glows warmly behind windows, with no sign or writing. Modern apartment facades, barred windows, subtle utility wires and wet sloped street, quiet intimate mood. No grand traditional or tourist architecture.
Composition: single wide 16:9 frame, native output 1792x1008 or greater matching ratio, rich fine detail. Main narrative landmarks left and center; right third visually calm open pavement and plain dim residential facade allowing a character portrait overlay. Bottom third is simple wet pavement/steps, contains no required landmarks. Accurate perspective, natural scale.
Style: polished movie-still quality semi-realistic visual novel environmental illustration like input 1, refined painterly realism, physically coherent soft illumination, restrained amber on cool slate teal, no excessive blur. Completely empty of people, no silhouettes, no faces, no readable text, no lettering, no brand logos, no watermark, no UI, no border. Preserve local urban authenticity, NOT an ancient town or fantasy village.

assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: finished visual novel game background. Create one new environmental scene derived from these references, no collage.
Reference roles: first input modern Bijie residential sloping street photo establishes contemporary real local architecture and slope shape, barred windows, many overhead utility wires and urban density; second gray and red brick courtyard supplies worn wall texture and greenery, exclude its person; third input bg-street.png supplies ONLY polished cinematic semi-realistic visual novel art finish, not its night weather.
Scene: a quiet residential sloping lane in contemporary Bijie, Guizhou on an overcast afternoon just after rain, suitable for a gentle walk/date dialogue. Pedestrian eye-level view up a modest concrete slope, a small turning junction in midground left-center. Everyday 3-to-5-floor concrete and small-tile apartment facades, barred windows, irregular old gray and red brick retaining walls, some green vines, overhead utility cables across the narrow street. Ground is only slightly damp with a few quiet shallow runnels along the roadside; no active rainfall, no flooding, no torrential rain, no golden evening sunset. Soft blue-gray daylight, muted teal-gray concrete and natural green vines, subdued warm brown brick. Urban Bijie authenticity, no ancient town, no fantasy, no tourist landmarks.
Composition: single wide 16:9 landscape, native output 1792x1008 or greater matching ratio, high environmental detail. Main architecture and intersection left and middle; right third low visual complexity with plain residential wall / open path for portrait overlay. Bottom third understated smooth damp road without indispensable landmarks. No vehicles obscuring the scene.
Style: cinematic semi-realistic visual novel background painting consistent with third reference's rendering and careful realistic perspective. Absolutely empty: no people, silhouettes, human reflections, faces, animals, signage, words, text, numbers, logos, watermark, UI, border. Do not reproduce reference watermarks or readable advertisements.
